caption: The drawing depicts a square or rectangular section of what appears to be a decorative wrought iron or ornamental metal fence or railing. The design consists of interwoven branches or vine-like elements that form an intricate pattern within the borders of the fence section. There are several large, pointed leaves distributed along the “branches,” with a total of three leaves on the topmost horizontal bar, and more leaves spread along the curved and angular branches throughout the central portion. In the center, the branches curve to form a circular shape, emphasizing the focus of the pattern. The drawing is rendered in grayscale, with shading used to add depth and detail to both the leaves and the branches. The entire composition sits within the squared framework, and the artist's signature “Chas T. Moss” with the year “37” is visible in the lower left corner of the image. The background is plain and uncolored, highlighting the detailed ironwork design.
title: Porch Railing
